title: When the setting for saving requests to non-existent pages (404) is enabled, JTL-Shop stores the raw requested URL in…
description: JTL-Shop has a vulnerability where enabling the setting to save requests to non-existent pages (404) causes the raw requested URL to be stored and rendered without output encoding in the administration backend. This allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject script code that executes in the administrator's browser session when viewing the affected redirect, potentially enabling actions with administrator privileges. The setting is disabled by default in new installations but may still be enabled in older ones.
